# React Bits components used by the workbench

Dock and SpotlightCard are vendored unchanged from the official [DavidHDev/react-bits](https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits) repository, commit `e12c22192ac7b4b452c5e2feb9b586d74765d696`.

`SOURCES.json` records original paths and SHA-256 hashes. `LICENSE.md` is the upstream **MIT + Commons Clause** license; these are used as components of this application, not redistributed as a component product. Integration styles live in `features/work/aurora.css`.

The procedural WebGL background and panel expansion are original workbench code. They do not use Active Theory code, assets, branding or Hydra. No runtime third-party assets or APIs are required.
